media:group.media:title: Pod – Power of the People
media:group.media:description:
Pod is one of the UK’s leading EV charging providers, powering homes, public spaces and workplaces. We were innovators right from the get-go, helping people make the switch to electric in the very early days of EV travel. Today, a quarter of a million customers trust us to be the heart of their EV life, and we power over 5 million miles every day.
We stand out in the EV market thanks to our award-winning technology, our heritage and our proven reliability. Our customers can be confident when they choose Pod on their electric journey.
We believe that people can power their lives while also protecting the planet. Our network is making clean energy easy, affordable and accessible for everyone.
Head to https://pod-point.com to find out more and kick-start your EV journey.

entry.title: Pod Point receives Best of British Business Award

media:group.media:title: Pod Point receives Best of British Business Award
media:group.media:description:
Pod Point has been designing and installing smart electric vehicle (EV) charging systems since 2009, when there was merely a few hundred EVs on the road.
Over the last 15 years, we’ve worked tirelessly to refine and improve our products and services, having the opportunity to shape EV charging infrastructure from the very start and lead the automotive transformation across the country. We always knew that drivers would be comfortable making the switch to electric, provided they have access to a reliable, convenient, and easy way to charge their vehicle.
Now, in 2024, we’ve reached 1.2m EVs on UK roads and Pod Point has installed 250,000 EV chargers; a stark contrast to our humble beginnings while EV adoption was in its infancy.
As a leading EV charging provider today, we continue to use these years of experience and expertise to make charging even easier and more affordable. Just like electric cars have evolved in leaps and bounds since the early days of the industry, so have the ways to charge them. That means drivers are constantly on the lookout for a reputable and trusted brand that offers a reliable, convenient, and easy-to-use charging system.
That's why we couldn’t be prouder to receive a Best of British Award by The Independent and Business Reporter. Over a quarter of a million drivers trust us to power their EV lifestyle, and it’s products like our Solo 3S charger that continue to shape the future of home charging.
This award is testament to our commitment of driving forward the EV industry and demonstrating innovation and excellence in everything we’ve done over the last 15 years for our customers.
Find out more about our Award win here: https://www.business-reporter.co.uk/best-of-british-business/the-ev-charging-business-at-the-forefront-of-the-industrys-evolution

entry.title: What EV charging power rates are available?

media:group.media:title: What EV charging power rates are available?
media:group.media:description:
How do I know the charging rate of the #EV charger I’m using? The max charging rate will be shown on the charger or in the #PodPointApp.
We have a range of 3.6kW, 7kW, 22kW, 50kW, and 75kW chargers, so your charging speed will depend on which one you use, what type of charging cable you have, if load balancing is in operation at the site, and your EV’s capabilities.
Explore public charging on the Pod Point Network: https://pod-point.com/solutions/driver/network
